 {"id": "ka0400", "verbatim": "The ABL Facility imposes substantial operating and financial restrictions on us.", "paraphrase": "We are subject to significant operating and financial restrictions imposed by the ABL Facility.", "different_hard": "The ABL Facility imposes no significant operating or financial restrictions on us."},
 {"id": "ka0401", "verbatim": "We could experience delays or defaults in payment from these REPs, which could negatively affect our cash flows, financial condition and results of operations.", "paraphrase": "Late or missed payments from these REPs could reduce our cash flows and harm our financial condition and results of operations.", "different_hard": "We could experience delays or defaults in payment to these REPs, which could adversely affect our cash flows, financial condition and results of operations."},
 {"id": "ka0402", "verbatim": "Environmental laws and regulations have generally become more stringent over time, although this trend could change in the short term under the new U.S. presidential administration.", "paraphrase": "Although environmental laws and regulations have generally become stricter over time, the new U.S. presidential administration could reverse this trend in the near term.", "different_hard": "Environmental laws and regulations have generally become less stringent over time, and this trend is expected to continue in the near term under the new U.S. presidential administration."},
 {"id": "ka0403", "verbatim": "We are also subject to potential liability for the remediation of contamination associated with both current and past hazardous waste generation, handling, and disposal activities.", "paraphrase": "We may also be held potentially liable for cleaning up contamination arising from hazardous waste generation, handling and disposal activities, both current and historical.", "different_hard": "We are not subject to liability for the remediation of contamination associated with present or past hazardous waste generation, handling, and disposal activities."},
 {"id": "ka0404", "verbatim": "Absent substantial price increases, cost ceiling write-downs may be necessary in the future.", "paraphrase": "Unless prices rise significantly, we may need to write down our cost ceilings at some point.", "different_hard": "Absent significant price increases, cost ceiling write-downs are not expected in the future."},
 {"id": "ka0405", "verbatim": "The classification of our gross operating income as income from services, which should not be considered passive income for purposes of the PFIC income test, or rents, which could be passive income for that purpose, is a facts and circumstances determination that takes into consideration many factors and the weight that should be given to each factor and is currently subject to considerable uncertainty under the U.S. federal income tax law.", "paraphrase": "Whether our gross operating income counts as services income, which is not passive income for PFIC income test purposes, or as rents, which may be passive income for that purpose, depends on the facts and circumstances, involving many factors and the weight given to each, and this classification is currently highly uncertain under U.S. federal income tax law.", "different_hard": "The classification of our gross operating income as income from services, which should be considered passive income for purposes of the PFIC income test, or rents, which could be passive income for that purpose, is a facts and circumstances determination that takes into consideration many factors and the weight that should be given to each factor and is currently subject to significant uncertainty under the U.S. federal income tax law."},
 {"id": "ka0406", "verbatim": "On March 3, 2018, we prepaid $80.0 million of the outstanding principal balance under our Term Loan B, funded by cash on hand.", "paraphrase": "We used cash on hand to make a $75.0 million prepayment against the outstanding principal of our Term Loan B on February 17, 2017.", "different_hard": "On February 17, 2017, we prepaid $75.0 million of the outstanding principal balance under our Term Loan B, funded by borrowings under our revolving credit facility."},
 {"id": "ka0407", "verbatim": "Generally, for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2018, new IRS audit procedures will apply to the Trust.", "paraphrase": "New IRS audit procedures will generally apply to the Trust for taxable years that begin after December 31, 2017.", "different_hard": "Generally, for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2017, new IRS audit procedures will not apply to the Trust."},
 {"id": "ka0408", "verbatim": "competition from other office, industrial and bank branch properties;", "paraphrase": "rivalry posed by other office, industrial and bank branch buildings;", "different_hard": "reduced competition from other office, industrial and bank branch buildings;"},
 {"id": "ka0409", "verbatim": "We are heavily dependent on the Agencies to sell mortgage loans and any changes in these entities or their current roles could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.", "paraphrase": "Our business depends heavily on the Agencies as buyers of our mortgage loans, so any change to these entities or to their present roles could harm our business, financial condition and results of operations.", "different_hard": "We are highly dependent on the Agencies to sell mortgage loans and any changes in these entities or their current roles could favorably affect our business, financial condition and results of operations."},
 {"id": "ka0410", "verbatim": "Our ability to respond to minimum wage increases by increasing menu prices would depend on the reactions of our competitors and consumers.", "paraphrase": "Whether we can pass minimum wage increases on to customers through higher menu prices depends on how competitors and consumers respond.", "different_hard": "Our ability to respond to minimum wage increases by increasing menu prices would not depend on the responses of our competitors and consumers."},

 {"id": "ka0417", "verbatim": "Many of our agreements provide for services on a fixed price or fee-for-service with a cap basis and, accordingly, we bear the financial risk if we initially under-price our contracts or otherwise overrun our cost estimates.", "paraphrase": "Because many of our contracts are priced on a fixed price or fee-for-service with a cap basis, we bear the financial risk if we set our initial prices too low or exceed our cost estimates in other ways.", "different_hard": "Many of our contracts provide for services on a fixed price or fee-for-service with a cap basis and, accordingly, the customer bears the financial risk if we initially under-price our contracts or otherwise overrun our cost estimates."},
